tool_input.command:
cd <repo>
git add README.md CONTRIBUTING.md
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix: address Copilot findings on PR #248 (toolchain minimum, fail-closed path)

- CONTRIBUTING.md's toolchain-download claim didn't state the Go
  toolchain directive itself needs 1.21+ to parse -- older than that,
  go.mod fails before any auto-download can happen. Tightened wording.
- README.md's fallback paragraph conflated two distinct cases:
  resolve.go:82-91 fails closed (returns an error, no fallback) when a
  handle IS resolved but its ethos identity file is missing/unreadable
  -- only "no handle resolved at all" falls back to default-identity.
  Split the two cases out explicitly.
EOF
)"
git push 2>&1
tool_input.description: Commit and push the Copilot-finding fixes
